method: targeted Kyrgyz-English semantic review against printed page and adjacent context; inventory-142 manuscript alignment remains provisional
checked_by: Codex with parallel agent proposal reviewed by root
uncertainty: Positions 1-3 form a causative threat; exact role of the сынчы remains uncertain.
Position 16 uses an obscure epithet; wording is provisional.
Positions 31-40 compress a world-closing storm image; exact line 37 verb and line 40 syntax need specialist review.
Positions 45-50 use livestock and bodily metaphors; referent of жал-куйрук and force of копол are provisional.
Positions 67-76 shift through a death image into booty and inheritance; direct-speech boundaries need review with adjacent pages.
Position 78 is causative; the person placed on horseback is not identified within this page.

corrections.en: Before the judges of horses,
corrections.reason: Сынчы denotes a judge or expert; каратып is having someone look or inspect. The object is supplied by surrounding speech and remains somewhat uncertain.

corrections.en: Having the strongmen beat you,
corrections.reason: Балбан is a wrestler or strongman; сабатып is causative, having someone beaten.

corrections.en: Having your hair braided in fives,
corrections.reason: Бештен is in groups of five; өрдүрүп is causative braid, not raise.

corrections.en: The possessions in your hands
corrections.reason: The line begins a clause completed by line 5.

corrections.en: I will let hostile hands destroy,
corrections.reason: Суук кол is an idiom for a harmful or hostile hand; бүлдүрүп is cause to ruin.

corrections.old: If I don't insult you like a sheep,
corrections.en: If I do not humiliate you like a sheep,
corrections.reason: Койдой кордук салбасам is a first-person conditional threat.

corrections.old: If I don't make a loot letter
corrections.en: If I do not take you as a captive wife,
corrections.reason: Олжо катын means a woman or wife taken as booty; not a letter.

corrections.old: Let me sink into the night without being born,
corrections.en: May I perish as though never born,
corrections.reason: Туулбай туна чөгөйүн is a formulaic oath wishing one's own birth undone.

corrections.en: May I die instead of living!
corrections.reason: Tирүү жүрбөй өлөйүн continues the self-imprecating oath.

corrections.en: What use is my being a hero?
corrections.reason: Баатыр болуп нетейин is rhetorical 'what shall I do being a hero?'

corrections.en: Raising a great tumult and uproar,
corrections.reason: Улуу жаңжал чуу салып is the speaker's threatened action, not a completed event.

corrections.old: Let me get to the bottom of you,
corrections.en: I will bring you to your end,
corrections.reason: Бир түбүңө жетейин is threatening to finish the addressee, not discover a secret.

corrections.en: Semetey, in whom you put your trust,
corrections.reason: Ишенгениң is 'the one you trust'; Semetey is the named referent.

corrections.old: If I don't press your head down,
corrections.en: If I do not bring your head low,
corrections.reason: Төбөңдү төмөн баспасам is first-person conditional.

corrections.old: It's a bad thing that hits you from the top,
corrections.en: You ill-fated one struck from above,
corrections.reason: Бейтаалай is ill-fated person; exact force of төбөңдөн тийген is figurative and uncertain.

corrections.old: If you don't give me four pieces,
corrections.en: If I do not scatter your four kinds of livestock,
corrections.reason: Төрт түлүк is the traditional four classes of livestock; first-person conditional retained.

corrections.en: What use is my being Sarybay?
corrections.reason: Сарыбай is a proper name; болуп нетейин is rhetorical.

corrections.old: Until he was abused by his wife,
corrections.en: Rather than suffer shame at a woman's hands,
corrections.reason: Зайыптан is from a woman; көргүчө 'rather than suffer'.

corrections.en: I will wage war without asking leave,
corrections.reason: Сурабай is without asking; согуш салайын is first-person resolve.

corrections.en: That swaggering wanton woman,
corrections.reason: Шуркуя is an insulting term for a wayward or daring woman; сумсаңдаган suggests stealthy or swaggering movement, uncertain nuance.

corrections.en: If I do not take her as my captive,”
corrections.reason: Олжо кылып албасам is take as spoil; closes the direct speech.

corrections.en: So Sarybay spoke,
corrections.reason: Деп marks the end of Sarybay's speech.

corrections.old: A lot of conflict is a big noise
corrections.en: A great quarrel and mighty uproar
corrections.reason: Арбын жаңжал улуу чуу denotes much strife and loud turmoil.

corrections.en: Were flaring higher and higher,
corrections.reason: Түтөп кетип баратат literally smoldering or billowing as events develop.

corrections.en: Still more than before
corrections.reason: Баштагыдан ансайын means all the more than earlier.

corrections.en: They were growing fiercer.
corrections.reason: Күчөп кетип баратат is ongoing intensification.

corrections.old: Sarybay the moon and the universe,
corrections.en: Sarybay seemed to overwhelm the whole world,
corrections.reason: Ай-ааламды is the entire world; line 30 completes verb басып кетип баратат.

corrections.en: Bearing down upon it.
corrections.reason: Басып кетип баратат is press or trample onward, not simply walking away.

corrections.en: His old quarrel
corrections.reason: Баштагыдай чатагы refers to previous quarrel.

corrections.en: Left no opening in the world,
corrections.reason: Жылчыгы жок is without a gap or opening; possibly hyperbolic rather than literal.

corrections.en: Closing it in on every side.
corrections.reason: Бүтөп is to close or block, not run out.

corrections.en: Sarybay, as before,
corrections.reason: Сарыкең is familiar or affectionate form of Sarybay, not the color yellow.

corrections.en: Was growing still fiercer.
corrections.reason: Күчөп кетип баратат is ongoing intensification.

corrections.en: With a menacing roar,
corrections.reason: Айбаттанып conveys becoming fearsome; акылдап may be roaring or bellowing here, uncertain.

corrections.en: Raising a piercing cry,
corrections.reason: Ач айкырык is a sharp, loud cry; not a hungry scream.

corrections.en: Raising a shout of alarm,
corrections.reason: Айгайлаган чуу is loud shouting and tumult.

corrections.en: The swine had set his heart aflame,
corrections.reason: Күйгүзгөнү чочконун appears to be an angry epithet and the effect of the woman's words; syntax remains uncertain.

corrections.old: You fought on the stone field,
corrections.en: You fought on the stony field,
corrections.reason: Таш майданда чабыштың addresses 'you', recollecting combat.

corrections.old: How many times did you knock,
corrections.en: You clashed with me many times,
corrections.reason: Далай нечен is many; кагыштың is 'you clashed'.

corrections.old: If I say, you turned the spear,
corrections.en: When I thrust, you turned aside my spear,
corrections.reason: Сайсам is 'when/if I thrust'; найза кайрыдың is 'you deflected the spear'.

corrections.en: You bitter, vengeful bitch,
corrections.reason: Күйүтүң бар expresses a grievance or anguish; канчык is a direct insult, not a sad heart.

corrections.en: You left me without a single maned or tailed beast,
corrections.reason: Жал-куйрук means mane and tail, likely referring figuratively to horses or livestock; referent uncertain.

corrections.en: You inflicted that punishment on me.
corrections.reason: Санат кылып is to punish or deal harshly, not to categorize.

corrections.old: I don't have a horn to swim,
corrections.en: You left me no horn with which to butt,
corrections.reason: Сүзөөрүмө is for my butting; мүйүз horn, not swim.

corrections.en: You left me hornless and defenseless,
corrections.reason: Токол is hornless, figuratively helpless or without protection.

corrections.en: Only my wasted frame remains; I have no strength,
corrections.reason: Сүлдөр is a gaunt frame or remnant; алым is my strength, not a fee.

corrections.en: You left me clumsy and broken.
corrections.reason: Копол is awkward or ungainly; stronger 'broken' follows the preceding depletion but is interpretive.

corrections.old: If I don't fight without Ops,
corrections.en: If I do not start a boundless quarrel,
corrections.reason: Опсуз is excessive or beyond measure; first-person conditional.

corrections.old: If I don't make a loot letter.
corrections.en: If I do not take you as a captive wife,
corrections.reason: Олжо катын is woman taken as booty, not a letter.

corrections.en: I am Sarybay the hero,
corrections.reason: Retains name and self-identification, improves English article and phrasing.

corrections.en: If I do not take my revenge without relenting,
corrections.reason: Conditional oath: койбой plus кегим албасам vows to persist in taking revenge; avoids reversing the condition.

corrections.old: Let me sink into the night without being born,
corrections.en: May I perish as though never born,
corrections.reason: Repeated self-imprecating oath.

corrections.en: May I die instead of living.
corrections.reason: Repeated self-imprecating oath.

corrections.en: Fighting fiercely in earnest,
corrections.reason: Опсуз conveys excessive or tremendous intensity; чындап means in earnest.

corrections.en: Grappling chest to chest,
corrections.reason: Омуроолоп is to push with chest or shoulder, not merely stand upright.

corrections.old: If I don't fight without ops,
corrections.en: If I do not wage a furious war,
corrections.reason: Опсуз is excessive or extreme; first-person conditional.

corrections.old: If I don't make a loot letter.
corrections.en: If I do not take you as a captive wife,
corrections.reason: Олжо катын is woman taken as booty.

corrections.old: Let me sink into the night without being born,
corrections.en: May I perish as though never born,
corrections.reason: Repeated self-imprecating oath.

corrections.en: May I die instead of living.
corrections.reason: Repeated self-imprecating oath.

corrections.en: I am Sarybay the hero,
corrections.reason: Retains proper name and self-identification.

corrections.old: I'll throw a spear at you,
corrections.en: I will aim and thrust my spear,
corrections.reason: Тиктеп is to take aim; найза саяйын is to thrust or stab with a spear, not throw.

corrections.en: I will truly avenge myself.
corrections.reason: Кегим алайын is take revenge, not apologize.

corrections.old: Let me get to the bottom of you,
corrections.en: I will bring you to your end,
corrections.reason: Бир түбүңө жетейин is an adversarial threat.

corrections.old: The soul will never come back to the true place,
corrections.en: To that true place from which no soul returns,
corrections.reason: Барган жан келбес чын жай is a euphemism for death or the grave.

corrections.old: If I don't go by myself.
corrections.en: If I do not go there myself,
corrections.reason: Басып өзүм кетпесем is first-person conditional on going there; preserve the threat/oath syntax.

corrections.en: The pass to which every soul must go,
corrections.reason: Белес is a pass or ridge; барган every soul going, likely a death image.

corrections.en: If I do not cross over it.
corrections.reason: Ашып өтүп is crossing a pass, not going overboard.

corrections.en: Moving, alive, still undying,
corrections.reason: Retains the sequence of life and movement with closer poetic diction.

corrections.en: Huddling and saying, 'I am alive,'
corrections.reason: Кымтынып is curling or drawing oneself in; not merely pretending.

corrections.en: Gulping and saying, 'I will not die,'
corrections.reason: Жутунуп is gulping or swallowing; quoted thought retained.

corrections.en: I will claim my inheritance,
corrections.reason: Мураска жетейин is to attain an inheritance; the context and speaker's logic remain uncertain.

corrections.old: The letter he received from Oljo -
corrections.en: A woman taken as booty, he said,
corrections.reason: Олжодон алган катын is a woman taken as spoil; деп marks quoted speech, not a letter or a person named Oljo.

corrections.en: I will seize her as spoil.
corrections.reason: Олжо кыла кетейин is to take as booty; feminine object supplied by preceding line.

corrections.en: He burned with unbearable anguish,
corrections.reason: Опсуз intensifies; жанын күйгүзүп is burning the soul/heart; subject transition may be ambiguous.

corrections.en: Setting someone upon a horse,
corrections.reason: Мингизип is causative, putting someone on horseback; referent is unclear until the next page.

corrections.en: Thus his soul burned with pain,
corrections.reason: Минтип жанын күйгүзүп repeats the burning-soul image; syntactic continuation on next page.
